content:
将积分写成先对 \(y\) 积分：

\[
I=\iint_D f(x)f(x^2-y)\,d\sigma
=\int_{-1}^{2} x\left(\int f(x^2-y)\,dy\right)dx
\]

因为

\[
f(x^2-y)\neq 0 \iff -1\le x^2-y\le 2
\]

所以

\[
x^2-2\le y\le x^2+1
\]

且在该区间内 \(f(x^2-y)=x^2-y\)。于是内层积分为

\[
\int_{x^2-2}^{x^2+1} x(x^2-y)\,dy
\]

令 \(u=x^2-y\)，则 \(u\) 从 \(2\) 到 \(-1\)，

\[
\int_{x^2-2}^{x^2+1} x(x^2-y)\,dy
=x\int_{-1}^{2}u\,du
=x\left[\frac{u^2}{2}\right]_{-1}^{2}
=x\left(2-\frac12\right)
=\frac32x
\]

因此

\[
I=\int_{-1}^{2}\frac32x\,dx
=\frac32\left[\frac{x^2}{2}\right]_{-1}^{2}
=\frac32\cdot\frac{3}{2}
=\frac94
\]

答案：A
